warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the four-dimensional (2x2v) Vlasov-Maxwell kernels at P1: two configuration dimensions of Maxwell coupling, absent from every 1x check. In `rt_vlasov_weibel_2x2v_p1.c`, `alpha` (line 100) is the amplitude of the seed perturbation; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong 2x2v surface flux, a wrong two-dimensional Maxwell update or a wrong current coupling changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-09, rtol=1e-09 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 3.7e-4 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 2.3e-3 (worst files `elc-L2.gkyl` and `elc-L2.gkyl`), a headroom of about 427x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
